title: Let Grist be a creature card off the battlefield (and a legal commander)
clause: "As long as Grist isn't on the battlefield, it's a 1/1 Insect creature in addition to its other types." (Grist, the Hunger Tide)
why: game/zone_layers.go applies off-battlefield type changes only from a BATTLEFIELD static (StaticAbility.AffectsZones) and says 'off the battlefield no catalogued effect makes a card a creature'. Grist's ability is its own, functioning in hand/library/graveyard/exile/command/stack with no battlefield source, and it needs P/T 1/1 there (cda_anywhere.go). deck/validate.go accepts a commander only if the type line is Legendary Creature or the text says 'can be your commander', so Grist is refused as a commander today. The rest of Grist (+1 repeat-mill, reflexive -2) is ordinary.
checked: read game/zone_layers.go header (AffectsZones, 'Not covered'); grep "isn't on the battlefield, it's" in effects/game: 0; grep 'grist' finds only gristle_glutton.go; git show fix-r2:server/internal/deck/validate.go lines 143, 189, 375-401.

cards.name: Grist, the Hunger Tide
cards.oracle_text:
As long as Grist isn't on the battlefield, it's a 1/1 Insect creature in addition to its other types.
+1: Create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token, then mill a card. If an Insect card was milled this way, put a loyalty counter on Grist and repeat this process.
−2: You may sacrifice a creature. When you do, destroy target creature or planeswalker.
−5: Each opponent loses life equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
